name: BizCore – Essential Website Modules
author: bizcore

sections.description:
BizCore gives you a suite of lightweight, shortcode-powered modules for your WordPress site.

Set global styles & colors plus styles can be overridden on a per-shortcode basis. Extra attributes with each shortcode make them highly customizable to fit in with the design of your theme.

View The Demos | View The Docs

Included Modules

  • Business Locations — display unlimited locations with addresses & contact details
  • Google Maps — display Google maps based on your business locations
  • Opening Hours — show your business opening hours
  • Contact Form — simple contact form with field ordering, custom messages, honeypot spam protection
  • Testimonials & Reviews — star ratings, images, text, names, roles
  • Team Members — image, name, role, department, contact & social links
  • Business Notices — time-sensitive announcements with start/end schedules
  • CTA Blocks — styled call-to-action sections with buttons
  • Buttons — unlimited styled, singular buttons that can link to anywhere
  • Social Links — Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok and more

Each module supports flexible attributes for IDs, layouts, styling variants, image sizes and shapes, custom classes, before/after wrappers, and more.

Fully theme-agnostic and lightweight, BizCore styling adds less than ~30kb of CSS to your site.

Using The Shortcodes

Everything is configured in one central Settings → BizCore page, you then simply drop in any of the following shortcodes wherever you need them:

  • Opening Hours [bizcore_hours]
  • Business Locations [bizcore_location]
  • Google Maps [bizcore_location_map]
  • Contact Form [bizcore_contact_form]
  • Testimonials & Reviews [bizcore_testimonials]
  • Team Members [bizcore_team]
  • Business Notices [bizcore_notices]
  • Call To Actions [bizcore_cta]
  • Buttons [bizcore_buttons]
  • Social Links [bizcore_social]

Here is an example of the Team Members shortcode with some attributes set:

[bizcore_team columns="2" heading="h5" icon_style="fontawesome" icons="true" layout="horizontal" style="modern_circles" class="text-center"]

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.9 or higher
  • PHP 7.0 or higher

Usage

  1. Configure global settings (colors, typography, style variants) under BizCore Settings.
  2. Add your content for each module under Settings → BizCore tabs.
  3. Insert shortcodes into your content.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the bizcore folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate BizCore through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → BizCore to configure your modules.
  4. Place any of the provided shortcodes into pages, posts, or widgets.
sections.faq:
Is BizCore free?

Yes! BizCore’s core modules are 100% free and will remain free.
